description: Generate a combined .gitignore from template keys. Operations: "generate" — Combine one or more template keys into a .gitignore.; "templates" — List the available .gitignore template keys.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: generate: Comma- or space-separated template keys (e.g. "node,python,macos"). templates: Unused (pass an empty string).

operation.description: generate — Combine one or more template keys into a .gitignore. templates — List the available .gitignore template keys.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

name: gitignore
title: .gitignore Generator
